title: compat: negotiate events stream format from Accept
body:
This picks up the events Accept items from #30164 and #30165. Newer docker clients send Accept with jsonl, x-ndjson and json-seq on GET /events and pick their decoder from the Content-Type we send back, so I added a small q-value aware helper in apiutil and use it in the compat events handler. json-seq records get the RS prefix. Libpod requests and compat versions below 1.52 still get plain application/json, and jsonl is only offered from 1.53.

There's a unit test for the negotiation, one for the version gating, and an apiv2 check on the returned Content-Type.
